strings.tl: I see... // [1]Thank you so much for coming all this way to tell me.

strings.jp:
{1c:10}いえ・・・
{10}さんに責任はありません。
責任はむしろ私達の方・・・{1a}神の{e084}を守ることだけを{e085}え、
人間としての生き方を
{e085}えられなかった
アノイア{e085}{e086}にあると思います。{0c:fe}

strings.en:
{1c:10}No... The blame does not lie with you,
{10}-san. If anything, it lies with
us...{1a}with the Anoian Church, I believe, which
taught only the keeping of God's law,
and could not teach how to live as a
human being.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: No... The blame does not lie with you, [HERO]-san. If anything, it lies with us... // with the Anoian Church, I believe, which taught only the keeping of God's law, and could not teach how to live as a human being.

strings.jp:
{1c:10}いえ、
{10}さんには感謝しています。{1a}ルカさんは最期の時、
心から『ありがとう』を
言ったのでしょうから・・・{1a}{0c:520800}ありがとう、{10}さん。
ルカさんの分もお礼を言います。{0c:fe}
